content:
Hi, i wanted to know if there is a way to go to the lean source code of the Lean file which is showing that page, like on github?
Example, i have Something.lean which imports Verso and has some content, and when I am on the website, somewhere on the page at top i could click button and go see this lean file.

Any ideas on how to do this?

We don't have that at the moment as a feature.

If you don't mind providing the root directory of the files at HTML build time, then you could save the source files using metaprogramming and construct links that way. This is a bit complicated because there's not a 1-1 mapping between Verso files and HTML files - a single big HTML page might be built from multiple smaller Lean files. Maybe each section header should have a link?
